description: Phase 5.1 Summary Generation Logic - implement backend summary generation with strict tier cadence enforcement and redacted missed-schools counts.

userStories.title: Enforce cadence policy by user tier
userStories.description: As a FREE/PREMIUM user, summary generation should only run for allowed cadence (FREE weekly, PREMIUM daily).
acceptanceCriteria: FREE + daily request returns ineligible(cadence_mismatch)
FREE + weekly request proceeds on eligible path
PREMIUM + weekly request returns ineligible(cadence_mismatch)
PREMIUM + daily request proceeds on eligible path
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Aggregate updates for selected schools within summary window
userStories.description: As a user, generated summary should only include updates from my selected schools in the specified time window.
acceptanceCriteria: Aggregation only considers user-selected schools
Window boundaries are respected
Repeated runs on same fixture data produce deterministic counts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Compute missed-schools count with strict redaction
userStories.description: As a user, I should see how many selected schools had no updates, without exposing school names.
acceptanceCriteria: missedSchoolsCount is accurate for mixed update/no-update scenarios
No school names are included in missed-schools messaging/payload
All-updated scenario returns missedSchoolsCount = 0
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Expose scheduler-ready summary generation entrypoint
userStories.description: As Phase 5.2 scheduler, I can call one backend function and receive typed generation output with metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Entrypoint returns typed status for eligible/ineligible/error outcomes
Output includes plan, cadence, windowStart/windowEnd, generatedAt, and summary payload
Handles no-selected-schools and no-updates edge cases gracefully
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add test matrix and CI evidence for summary logic
userStories.description: As engineering, we need confidence that cadence rules, aggregation, and redaction remain correct.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests cover tier-cadence matrix
Unit tests cover aggregation + missedSchoolsCount logic
Unit tests cover redaction guarantees and edge cases
Lint, typecheck, and tests pass
CI evidence is documented in PR
